We employ the following metrics: 1. Bias score: Bias score in disambiguated contexts: Bias score in ambiguous contexts: The BBQ bias score measures a model's reliance on social stereotypes.

Each template was independently reviewed by each annotator in an isolated setting to prevent any external influences. Each annotator was asked to: • Identify the stereotyped group: Determine the social, ethnic, religious, or demographic group being targeted in the template. • Assign a bias relevance score: Evaluate the cultural relevance of the bias in the Pakistani context using the following scale: -1 Low cultural relevance: The bias is minimally or not at all applicable in the Pakistani context. -2 Moderate relevance: The bias has some applicability but may not be widely recognized or impactful. -3 High cultural relevance: The bias is deeply rooted or widely observed in Pakistani society.
guideline: Annotators were asked to identify the stereotyped group and assign a bias relevance score based on cultural applicability in Pakistan using a 3-point scale.
